_meta.source: US Census Bureau TIGERweb — Census Tracts 2020, Massachusetts (STATE=25)
_meta.format: TopoJSON, quantised + shared arcs; properties: { geoid }

simplification.method: Ramer–Douglas–Peucker on shared arcs, after cutting at junction vertices
simplification.note: Arcs are cut and simplified before dedupe, so neighbouring tracts share byte-identical borders and no gaps open between them.

_meta.roundTrip: decoded and verified: every shape present, every ring closed
_meta.caveat: Tract borders are cartographic, not legal boundaries. Display only.
